147. The King of the Black Sea, Gleyack (9)
Among the swords and magic, where chaos mixed and collided, only a small space where Talaris began to unfold the sealing ceremony emitted a pure white radiance.
It looked like a pearl that does not lose its light even in the deep sea.
As soon as Talaris began to unfold the absolute sealing ceremony, Gleyack focused all his attacks on her.
He did not defend himself in the slightest, despite his entire body being battered by the giants' attacks.
The torn black flesh of chaos continuously reverted to the blackened land, which was not the concept of regeneration commonly known to humans.
For the King of Chaos, 'form' was merely a means for the bare minimum of convenience.
The essence of Gleyack was not the body that became larger and more elaborate as the blackening progressed, but the chaotic energy itself that formed the shape and was mixed everywhere.
For instance, the giants' attacks were not inflicting actual damage on Gleyack, but merely distorting his form.
Even if there is a sword that splits the sea with one stroke, even if there is magic that can erase the sky with one blow.
They can't annihilate the sea and the sky themselves. Even if the waves stop and the clouds disappear, the sea and the sky always remain in their place.
The same was true for Gleyack. Despite receiving so many attacks, the chaos was scattered but not a single point was annihilated.
"What the hell is that?"
Murakan transformed into a human and stood next to Jin. Misha and Murakan, the two of them from the Vamel alliance, did not escape and stayed with Jin.
"Hey, demon. Is there really no answer to that?"
Misha shook her head. She was at the brink of exhaustion, absorbing Murakan's spirit energy to hold on.
"What do you think would happen if I found all my old power, can't you perform surgery or something right now? Even if it's a bit risky."

"If that was possible, I would have done it a long time ago. Please make sense when you talk. You need to stay focused and think. Right now, there's no other way than the one Jin mentioned. Kinzelo, they must have the means. They must respond to the negotiations too."
"Ah, then why are you still here? You've used up all your power. You should have left when the kids left! If the situation gets tangled, Jin and I have to take care of you too!"
"The situation was messed up from the moment that woke up. I also need to focus from now on, so shut up."
The reason Misha, who had exhausted most of her power, remained on the battlefield was simple.
There was still one thing she could do.
The absolute sealing ceremony of the maze.
Misha intended to help with it. The moment Gleyack woke up, she thought of the absolute seal of the maze as the only means to prepare to confront him.
"Maze Lord, I will help with the seal. The wall of chaos is thickening, and it will be too much for the seal of the maze alone to open the way."
Mort was a being of high stature, much like Tess, but also because of this, he could not fully utilize his original abilities in this world.
Furthermore, Mort was still tired as he had been making long-distance dimensional transfers ever since the Sword Emperor's Palace began.
In such dense chaos, there was a possibility that Mort's dimensional transfer ability might not open. Misha planned to counteract this part with her spirit energy.
"I was so desperate I hadn't considered that. I will trust you then, Misha."
Talaris did not ask Misha if she had ever performed a sealing ceremony with the Bow.
From the start, if you could not read its knots, you absolutely could not participate in the seal of the Bow.
Like food dropping onto pure white snow, spirit energy began to mix with the energy of the Bow.
The energy of the Bow and the spirit energy showed a better harmony than Talaris had expected.
'It seems she has conducted sealing ceremonies with past Bow masters. This will significantly reduce the burden.'
While the battlefield was filled with roars, the space where the sealing ceremony was taking place was filled with a strangely pleasant wind sound.
But that didn't mean it was safe.
Talaris, who was in the middle of unfolding the seal, suddenly spat out blood.
It was not Gliyak's sword or spear, or the energy of chaos that had struck her. All these attacks were being filtered out entirely by the giants, knights, magicians, and Jin and Murakan.
"Lady Talaris!"
The blackened land was the same as Gliyak's body. Gliyak had not only physically attacked, but he had also been using the black land on which Talaris stood since the beginning.
It was only being blocked by the thick ice of the Bow that covered the black ground.
The ice, which acted as a shield, was slowly being pierced.
The chaos chains and spikes rising from the ground out of nowhere couldn't be blocked by the others, and Talaris, who had entered the sealing ceremony, had to maintain complete immobility.
A dark chaos spike was protruding through her foot.
Talaris couldn't do anything about being struck by Gliyak's attack in this way.
That meant she had to be exposed to the chaos for a long time.
If the cold of the Bow hadn't immediately frozen the spike and wound, even Talaris wouldn't have been able to endure for ten minutes in that condition.
Watching this, Jin was almost mad.
However, showing signs of distress would only disturb Talaris.
Jin gritted his teeth and devoted himself to deflecting the attacks pouring from the front.
Two hours passed in this way.
The Bow was emitting a light much stronger and larger compared to when it first started.
It was complete.
Talaris was in a state of being pierced all over by the chaos spikes and tied with chains, covered in blood.
'Without Misha, we might not have succeeded.'
Talaris, who had been immobile throughout, reached out towards the Bow floating in the air for the first time.
Then, the light of the Bow all at once transferred onto her.
Bow Sword Demon Sealing Ceremony
Great Ice Field
The moment Talaris opened her eyes,
All movement on the battlefield stopped for a moment.
Hundreds of weapons wielded by Gliyak, the giants who fought against him, the knights, and the magicians. All of them stopped their actions at once due to the absolute sealing energy of the Bow.
As befitting the name of a huge plain covered in ice, there was no area not frozen no matter where you looked around.
The energy of chaos, which had been fiercely raging against humans until now, was frozen and shattered, scattered around the Great Ice Field like hazy snowflakes.
Talaris stood in the middle like a tree, spreading white energy. It was blinding to look at from the front.
Gliyak was freezing and breaking due to the energy of the seal. The chaotic energy forming his appearance was flowing away, like a sandcastle crumbling.
To those who didn't know the nature of the King of the Black Sea, the scene might seem like his complete end.
But even this did not fundamentally extinguish Gliyak's chaos.
When the time of the seal was up, the dispersed particles of chaos would again form Gliyak's appearance.
Also, Talaris was not at all satisfied with the result of the seal.
'Damn it, even though I unfolded it by drawing forth the power used to seal Elona Jifle one more time. Is this truly the limit...!'
The Great Ice Field was undoubtedly properly unfolded.
But it didn't completely seal Gliyak.
Talaris's gaze was directed beyond the Great Ice Field, at one object remaining like a black star.
It was a white stone.
Among all the frozen and shattered chaos, that cursed stone that woke Gliyak was still shimmering black.
And everyone felt it.
The white stone was spreading chaos and causing cracks in the Great Ice Field.
This was the moment when the three days that Talaris first foresaw became meaningless.
At most two days, or as short as one day.
Talaris concluded that this was the only time she could maintain the seal.
If there was a silver lining, it was that thanks to Mort's ability, she could also visit Kinzelo's main meeting within that time.
"We only have two days, or just one day. Misha, please open the path."
Boooong-!
Mort emerged from the Ice Crystal. When Misha cast a spell into the void, a tunnel formed that resembled a dimensional portal.
Mort instantly realized that this passage was auxiliary, aiding in the opening to another world.
Stem and Octavia climbed onto Mort's back. Keliac formed a message using the Seal of Fire to signify the temporary alliance between Runcandel and Jifle, and handed it to Octavia.
"How long will it take for the Master of Bow to reach the land of the beastmen?" Rosa asked.
"Given Mort's current condition, it will take approximately three to five hours."
"If Stem does not return within a maximum of twelve hours, we can consider the negotiations to have failed. Good luck, Sir Stem."
"Be careful as well, acting lord."
When Mort departed, the aura passage closed.
Meanwhile, even after the sealing had begun, Ron was still persistently charging at the white stone and swinging Rashid.
Swoosh-!
Ron's attack was blocked by the barrier of the black stone. Nevertheless, he didn’t stop, continuously swinging his sword on the barrier.
Nobody dared to stop Ron. Since his resurrection, he seemed like a vengeful spirit, determined to fight until his body gave out.
The sound of the blade clashing against the barrier resonated like Ron's suppressed roar.
Just as Talaris had predicted, Mort arrived in the land of the beastmen after five hours.
Contrary to those suffering in their own hell, Kinzelo and the land of the beastmen didn't seem much different from usual.
Kinzelo even showed them that he had deployed members across the land of the beastmen in advance, enabling them to directly navigate to the main council without getting lost.

Upon arrival, Stem and Octavia, guided by the first group of beastmen they encountered, headed towards Kinzelo's main council. The labyrinthine architecture, presumably constructed by the cat tribe, made it impossible to memorize the path to the council.

"So, you're saying that Runcandel and Jifle have temporarily sealed the King of the Black Sea, and if we don't join the fight, they will abandon him and direct all their forces here?" questioned Zephyrin, who had stepped forward as Kinzelo's representative and confirmed the Seal of Fire.
"That's correct."
Zephyrin studied them for a while, his eyes not smiling, only the corners of his mouth turned up.
"Excuse me if this sounds rude, but it seems like you know too little."
"What do you mean?"
"Do you really believe,"
That you can escape from the fifth king of chaos and attack us?
As Zephyrin finished his sentence, his smile faded away.
